title: 第一卷 第23章 本尊就说你会后悔的第一卷 第24章 话又说回来本尊没错
slug: 失踪十年小师妹让全宗门跪下迎接
content_zh:
至于雷子越。
那就是个有勇无谋的蠢货，有他在的话说不定还会坏事儿。
苏明月看得出来，雷子越虽然维护自己，可对洛还真却不是没有感情，甚至还在等她悔悟回到师门，肯定会阻止自己对洛还真下手。
苏明月觉得与其被他拖后腿，倒还不如自己先悄悄把洛还真解决了，等拿到寻宝法器，再去和雷子越汇合也不迟。
到时候她负责指挥和发现宝物，雷子越负责当苦力，轻松又省事。
没有人拖后腿，洛还真率领众弟子赶路的速度很快，距离太阳下山还有一段时间，众人便已经爬上了灵山宗。
离开十里山路，灵力限制也被解除，众弟子顿时觉得浑身一阵轻松。
洛还真站在石墩子上，小胖手叉腰，一副小小大姐头的模样，“安静一点，听本尊说话。”
众弟子立刻噤声，眼巴巴地看向洛还真。
洛还真奶声奶气道：“现在已经上山啦，你们可以自己离开去寻找机缘！如果想跟着本尊走也可以，但是遇到的所有机缘宝物都要出力并上交，遇到危险要也互相帮助，等结束后由本尊来分！而且本队伍不允许搞特权卖惨，靠博取同情拿资源！”
此言一出，众弟子不由得握拳振臂，“就冲这句话，小师叔我跟你！”
“我也跟！”
“这才是一个正常的领队该有的态度，支持小师叔！”
“跟定小师叔！”
弟子们的情绪有些激动。
他们大都是从雷子越那边新加入进来的，对比之前雷子越的强行偏袒，资源优先，遇到事情只想着苏明月一人，洛还真现在的这番发言简直说到他们的心坎里去了。
雷师兄甚至还不如一个小孩！
情到浓时，众人忍不住纷纷吐槽起雷子越和苏明月师兄妹的自私行径起来。
苏明月躲在暗处盯着这一切，听见他们那些话，气得咬牙切齿——
一群趋炎附势的臭走狗。

还有洛还真，顶着个奶娃娃模样，装出一副天真懵懂的样子，没想到心机和城府竟然这么深，竟然知道踩着她拉拢人心，故意抢风头。
等着吧。等她拿到寻宝法器，这些说她坏话的弟子，有一个算一个，都别想来蹭她的机缘和宝贝。
最后，玄天宗弟子无一人离开，竟全都选择跟洛还真走。
自己单打独斗，哪里有组队刷秘境轻松。尤其在洛还真这个人体宝物感应器在的情况下。
洛还真迈着小短腿，带着自己乌泱泱的队伍稳步前进。
在洛还真的带领下，众弟子沿途陆续发现了灵药丛、一棵巨大的蕴灵果树以及一座小型玄铁矿洞，还又杀死了两只活物宝贝，其中一个是医修炼制极品续命丹药必备的万年人参，另一个则是非常罕见，锻造重塑时加入进去能提升本命法器品质的墨纹玄金……
苏明月一边嫉妒地看他们收获得盆满钵满，一边偷偷运转功法蓄力，反复查探洛还真的灵力境界。
炼气初期一层境界没错。
她头上的那个小破旗子在这里面没法用，自己要杀她，和碾死一只小蚂蚁没有任何区别。
直至金乌西坠，在丛生青木的掩映下，一个由巨大青石砖砌成的大型宫殿遗址出现在众人的眼前。
宫殿墙体生满青苔，在阳光下散发出古朽的气息。巨大的宫门上，残存着三个褪色的大字——苍华殿
“是七十二宫殿之一，苍华殿！这个宫殿里是灵药园和养灵池之类的东西，危险程度比起其他宫殿要小很多。”
“往年参加秘境的宗门最快找到宫殿的，也花了三天，我们只用了一天！”
“小师叔好厉害，我们跟着小师叔算是跟对了！”
洛还真骄傲仰头，接受这些夸赞。等听够了，才小手一挥，奶声奶气道：“肘！我们进去！”
content_en:
As for Lei Ziyue.
That's a fool, and he might do bad things if he's around.
Su Mingyue could see that although Lei Ziyue defended himself, he did not have no feelings for Luo Huanzhen. He was even waiting for her to repent and return to the school, which would definitely prevent her from attacking Luo Huanzhen.
Su Mingyue felt that instead of being held back by him, it would be better for her to quietly deal with Luo Huanzhen first, and then it would not be too late to join Lei Ziyue after getting the treasure hunting artifact.
When the time comes, she will be responsible for commanding and discovering treasures, while Lei Ziyue will be responsible for working as a coolie, which is easy and hassle-free.
No one was holding back, Luo Huanzhen led the disciples on the road very quickly. There was still some time before the sun set, and everyone had already climbed up to Lingshan Sect.
After leaving the ten-mile mountain road, the restrictions on spiritual power were also lifted, and the disciples suddenly felt relaxed.
Luo Huanzhen stood on the stone pier, with his hands on his hips, looking like a young lady, "Be quiet and listen to me."
All the disciples immediately fell silent and looked at Luo Huanzhen eagerly.
Luo Huanzhen said in a sweet voice: "Now that we have gone up the mountain, you can leave and find opportunities by yourself! If you want to follow me, you can, but you must contribute and hand in all chance treasures you encounter, and you must help each other when in danger. I will divide it up after the end! And this team does not allow special privileges to be used to gain resources, and we rely on gaining sympathy to gain resources!"
As soon as these words came out, all the disciples couldn't help but clench their fists and raise their arms, "That's it, little master uncle, I'll follow you!"
"I'll follow too!"
"This is the attitude a normal team leader should have, support my junior uncle!"
"Follow Junior Uncle Ding!"
The disciples were a little excited.
Most of them were new recruits from Lei Ziyue. Compared with Lei Ziyue's previous forced favoritism, prioritizing resources, and only thinking about Su Mingyue when encountering problems, Luo Huanzhen's current speech simply spoke to their hearts.
Senior Brother Lei is even worse than a child!
As their love grew stronger, everyone couldn't help but complain about the selfish behavior of brothers and sisters Lei Ziyue and Su Mingyue.
Su Mingyue hid in the dark and stared at all this. When she heard their words, she gritted her teeth in anger——
A bunch of stinky lackeys who follow the trend.
There is also Luo Huanzhen, who pretends to be innocent and ignorant despite the appearance of a baby. Unexpectedly, his scheming and government are so deep that he actually knows how to step on her to win people's hearts and deliberately steal the limelight.
Just wait. When she gets the treasure-hunting magic weapon, none of these disciples who spoke ill of her will even think about taking advantage of her opportunity and treasure.
In the end, none of the Xuantian Sect disciples left, and all of them chose to follow Luo Huanzhen.
Fighting alone is not as easy as forming a team to clear the secret realm. Especially when Luo Huanzhen, the human treasure sensor, is present.
Luo Huazhen walked on his short legs and led his huge team forward steadily.
Under the leadership of Luo Huanzhen, the disciples discovered a spiritual medicine bush, a huge spirit-containing fruit tree, and a small black iron mine along the way. They also killed two more living creatures, one of which was a ten thousand-year-old ginseng that is necessary for medical practice to make the best life-sustaining elixir. The other was a very rare black-marked black gold that can be added during forging and reshaping to improve the quality of the natal magic weapon...
While Su Mingyue watched with jealousy as they gained a lot of money, she secretly ran the exercises to accumulate power and repeatedly tested Luo Huanzhen's spiritual power.
The first level of Qi refining is right.
The little broken flag on her head is useless here. Killing her is no different from crushing a little ant.
Until the Golden Crow fell to the west, under the cover of clumps of green trees, a large palace ruins made of huge bluestone bricks appeared in front of everyone.
The walls of the palace are covered with moss, exuding an ancient atmosphere in the sunlight. On the huge palace gate, three faded characters remain - Canghua Palace
"It's one of the seventy-two palaces, Canghua Palace! In this palace are things like the elixir garden and the spirit nourishing pond. It's dangerous.The extent is much smaller than other palaces. "
"In previous years, it took the sects who participated in the secret realm the fastest to find the palace in three days, but it only took us one day! "
"Uncle Junior is so awesome, we are doing the right thing by following Junior Uncle! "
Luo raised his head proudly and accepted these compliments. When he had heard enough, he waved his little hand and said in a sweet voice: "Elbow! Let's go in! "
